title: SIDESTORY: SO LONG, ADELE: HOME AWAY FROM HOME OPEN
lines: 01 [4TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] SIDESTORY: SO LONG, ADELE: HOME AWAY FROM HOME OPEN
EVENT DURATION: January 16, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) – February 13, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, participating in Siestan Fashion Street, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 3 phases:
- Phase 1
DURATION: January 16, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) – February 6, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Stages:
[A Holiday at the Hot Springs]
- Phase 2
DURATION: January 23, 2024, 16:00 (UTC-7) – February 6, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Stages:
[Treasurehunting in Siesta]
- Phase 3
DURATION: January 30, 2024, 16:00 (UTC-7) – February 6, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Stages:
[Surfing the Lava]
[Siestan Fashion Street]
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain rewards by purchasing and selling goods in "Siestan Fashion Street".
REWARD: Mountaincomm Trade Supplies (provides random materials), Trip to the 'White Volcano' Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
[Dolly's Task List]
Event Instructions : During the event, players can complete [Dolly's Task List] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
Reward : [★★★★★: Bryophyta], Trip to the 'White Volcano' Furniture (Pieces), Fluffy Critter Wool, Module Materials, etc.
['White Volcano']
DURATION: January 16, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) – February, 13, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Fluffy Critter Wool. Fluffy Critter Wool can be used to redeem items in ['White Volcano'].
Reward : Bryophyta's token, Trip to the 'White Volcano' Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
- During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
02 [4TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – CLOUDTOP LUCID DREAMS
DURATION: January 16, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 30, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Cloudtop Lucid Dreams], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting
★★★★★★: Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska (Limited) / Swire the Elegant Wit
★★★★★★: Gavial the Invincible (Limited) / Ch'en the Holungday (Limited)
★★★★★: Poncirus
NOTE:
- [Cloudtop Lucid Dreams] is part of the [Limited Headhunting-Carnival] headhunting series.
- [Limited Headhunting-Carnival] is Limited Headhunting.
- After the [Cloudtop Lucid Dreams] banner ends, [Swire the Elegant Wit] and [Poncirus] will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after January 30, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Operator [Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska] is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting-Carnival], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.
- After the [Cloudtop Lucid Dreams] banner ends, [Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska] will NOT become available in any other [Limited Headhuntings] before July 1, 2024.
- NOTE : Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 [4TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] SPECIAL LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: January 16, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 30, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Log in during the event to claim reward on event page: [Footprints of the Clouds Headhunting Permit]*1
NOTE:
- Footprints of the Clouds Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [Cloudtop Lucid Dreams] Limited Headhunting.
- Each account can only claim this reward once during the event.
- Footprints of the Clouds Headhunting Permit expires at: January 30, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
04 [4TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] DAILY FREE ROLL IN [CLOUDTOP LUCID DREAMS] LIMITED HEADHUNTING
DURATION: January 16, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 30, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A free roll can be performed every day during the event in [Cloudtop Lucid Dreams] Limited Headhunting.
NOTE:
- Daily Free Roll will be refreshed at 04:00 (UTC-7) every day.
- Daily Free Roll can only be used once a day and will not accumulate.
05 [4TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] NEW OPERATOR NOW AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game
★★★★★★: Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska [Limited]
★★★★★★: Swire the Elegant Wit
★★★★★: Poncirus
★★★★★: Bryophyta
Note :
- Operator Bryophyta is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home, and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
- Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska, Swire the Elegant Wit, Poncirus, and Bryophyta will gain more trust in the event stages during January 16, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) – February 6, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
06 [4TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] MISTY WONDERLAND LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: January 16, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 30, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 10 days to receive generous rewards, including: Exclusive Outfit for Chestnut, Event Exclusive Furniture, Orundum, and etc.
Day 1: Bunny New Year's Cutout, LMD * 30000
Day 2: Orundum * 200, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Skill Summary – 2 * 20, 'Hot Tub' Furniture * 1
Day 4: Chip Catalyst * 1, Furniture Part * 300
Day 5: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 6: Orundum * 200, Pure Gold * 20
Day 7: Data Supplement Instrument * 3, Skill Summary - 3 * 8
Day 8: LMD * 30000, Coral Coast Collection - Holiday HDm57 - Chestnut
Day 9: Module Data Block * 1, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 10: Orundum * 200, Tactical Battle Record * 20
07 [4TH ANNIVERSARY CELEBRATION] SIESTA GRAFFITI WALL OPEN
DURATION: January 16, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 30, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can get two trials for Beating Tickets after daily login. Consume trials to participate in the [Siesta Graffiti Wall]. Select Beating Tickets as permitted. The Beating Ticket with the most Orundum will be awarded.
NOTE:
- There are 14 days at most for players to pick Beating Tickets.
- Players will randomly obtain following amount of Orundum from Beating Tickets:
Orundum * 200, Orundum * 300, Orundum * 400, Orundum * 500, Orundum * 600, Orundum * 800

- If the amount of Orundum in daily reward is less than 400 (400 is NOT included), players will be granted an extra trial the next day. The extra trial cannot be accumulated, players can get 3 daily trials at most (including the extra trial).
- All the daily trials will be refreshed at 4:00 am on the next day and cannot be accumulated.
